owner.name: Amit Ayer
owner.headline: Chief AI Officer | LLM Product Launches | Strategic AI Partnerships

executive_summary: Senior AI and technology executive leading enterprise-wide LLM deployment, transformer model optimization, and generative AI platform launches across Fortune 500 financial services institutions. Delivered $50M in measurable client savings and revenue across twenty-plus regulated engagements by architecting multi-cloud AI solutions, embedding RAG pipelines, and accelerating fraud detection by 40% through low-latency inference optimization. Drove strategic AI partnerships with Snowflake, AWS, and Databricks to co-develop platforms that scaled enterprise generative AI adoption, secured $15M in partnership revenue, and achieved 25% increases in client renewal rates. Unified cross-functional commercial, technical, and risk leaders to translate AI strategy into executable programs, delivering audit-ready governance frameworks that reduced compliance remediation cycles by 35%. Advanced enterprise AI state-of-the-art by building scalable, high-performance platforms with embedded bias audit controls, data lineage tracking, and real-time regulatory reporting capabilities for CCAR and Basel III compliance.

professional_experience.title: Chief AI Officer
professional_experience.overview: Led enterprise generative AI and LLM solution delivery for Fortune 500 financial services clients, scaling senior ML engineering teams from five to eighteen members and accelerating production deployment timelines by 40% across regulated client programs.
highlights: Recruited and scaled senior LLM and ML engineering practice from five to eighteen members, delivering enterprise AI adoption for Fortune 500 financial clients and accelerating time-to-production across regulated programs.

Partnered with C-suite executives to align AI strategy with business outcomes, co-developing generative AI products that generated $30M in measurable client value and operational transformation initiatives.

Designed and deployed context-engineering frameworks with retrieval-augmented pipelines and semantic caching, improving generative AI accuracy by 35% while accelerating customer solution adoption across portfolio companies.

Built senior engineering teams focused on transformer models and attention mechanisms, delivering low-latency inference optimization and reducing fraud detection response times by 40% across client production deployments.

Architected LLM deployment pipelines with embedding stores, vector databases, and inference optimization techniques, cutting latency by 40% and improving model throughput to meet production SLAs for regulated workloads.

Deployed agentic API frameworks using chain-of-thought prompting to automate complex workflows, reducing manual intervention in reporting and operations by 30% while improving audit traceability for compliance requirements.
Led multi-year strategic partnerships with Snowflake, AWS, and Databricks to co-develop platforms and go-to-market programs that scaled enterprise generative AI adoption and secured $15M in revenue.

professional_experience.title: Lead Client Partner
professional_experience.overview: Directed global digital transformation programs across top-tier financial institutions, modernizing legacy risk systems for $30M in client engagements and reducing regulatory reporting cycles by 50% through cloud-native analytics migration.
highlights: Delivered $30M transformation by migrating legacy risk systems to cloud-native analytics platforms, cutting regulatory response times by 50% for global banking clients.
Established strategic alliances with AWS, Snowflake, and leading systems integrators to co-deliver enterprise solutions, generating $15M in incremental partnership revenue across thirty countries.
Integrated AI decision engines into risk platforms enabling real-time CCAR and Basel III regulatory reporting, raising client renewal rates by 25% across Fortune 500 accounts.
Launched machine learning risk analytics platform serving global markets, improving predictive accuracy by 15% while ensuring compliance with international regulatory frameworks including MiFID II.

Implemented NLP-based fraud analytics across multi-jurisdictional operations to reduce false positives by 30%, improving detection precision and accelerating investigation timelines for global banking clients.
Migrated large-scale Monte Carlo risk models to AWS HPC infrastructure, accelerating execution cycles by 40% and reducing annual compute costs by $3M.
Delivered automated Jenkins CI/CD pipelines with embedded Snyk security scanning, reducing production incidents by 35% and accelerating AI feature releases by 50% globally.
